root_cause: Folded settings omitted controls after building them under the visible SettingsBox content. Unmounted controls painted at default geometry over real rows.
fix: Parented SettingsWidgets stage unmounted controls under a hidden Qt-owned host; real form layouts reparent mounted controls. The existing detached lazy-category owner remains unchanged.

contracts: Unchanged black-column transmission test, including animation off/on calibration.
Eager and deferred controls stay invisible under mode and explicit show calls before mounting.
Actual form mounting makes the chosen control visible without exposing unused controls.
Qt owner destruction deletes all controls and QWidget descendants.
validation.scope: Linux offscreen Qt, CPU only, capped 4G private environment

limits: Focused regression repair only; original order-dependent failures and uninterrupted serial/memory acceptance remain open.
